name: Vorapaxar Sulfate

examples.title: Trial to Assess the Effects of Vorapaxar (SCH 530348; MK-5348) in Preventing Heart Attack and Stroke in Particpants With Acute Coronary…
examples.why: The trial was terminated at the request of the Data and Safety Monitoring Board.

summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, gave Vorapaxar Sulfate a high risk score of 72 for the liver and a low risk score of 35 for the heart [M]. In human research, one clinical study designed to see if the drug could prevent heart attacks and strokes was stopped early [4]. This study was ended specifically at the request of a Data and Safety Monitoring Board, which is an independent group that watches over participant safety during a trial [4].
